name: Semaglutide — 5mg
shortDescription: Research-grade GLP-1 receptor agonist peptide. Lyophilized, 5mg vial.
longDescription:
Research-grade Semaglutide peptide supplied as a lyophilized powder in a single 5mg vial. Intended strictly for laboratory and in-vitro research applications. Each lot is tested for purity by HPLC and ships sealed with a certificate of analysis on request.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
description: Research-grade GLP-1 receptor agonist peptide. Lyophilized, 5mg vial.

longDescription:

description: Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist peptide. Lyophilized, 10mg vial.

description: Triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist. Lyophilized, 5mg vial.

name: Bacteriostatic Water — 30 mL
shortDescription: 0.9% benzyl alcohol in sterile water. 30mL multi-dose vial.
longDescription:
Sterile bacteriostatic water suitable for laboratory reconstitution of lyophilized peptides and other research compounds. Preserved with 0.9% benzyl alcohol for multi-dose use. Supplied in a 30mL sealed glass vial with rubber septum.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
description: 0.9% benzyl alcohol in sterile water. 30mL multi-dose vial.

name: Research Syringes — 1mL, Box of 100
shortDescription: 1mL U-100 research syringes with fixed 29G needle. Box of 100, sterile.
longDescription:
Individually packaged, sterile 1mL research syringes with a fixed 29G × 1/2″ needle. Graduated in U-100 units for precise laboratory dosing. Latex-free. One hundred syringes per box.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
description: 1mL U-100 research syringes with fixed 29G needle. Box of 100, sterile.

name: Analytical Balance — 0.1 mg Readability
shortDescription: Benchtop analytical balance. 220g capacity, 0.1mg readability, internal calibration.
longDescription:
High-precision analytical balance for quantitative laboratory work. 220g capacity with 0.1mg readability, motorized internal calibration, and a draft shield for environmental stability. RS-232 and USB connectivity for data logging.

Calibrated at the factory; recalibration certificate available on request.
description: Benchtop analytical balance. 220g capacity, 0.1mg readability, internal calibration.

name: Vortex Mixer — Variable Speed
shortDescription: Benchtop vortex mixer. 0–3000 rpm continuous and touch-activated modes.
longDescription: Compact benchtop vortex mixer with variable-speed control from 0 to 3000 rpm. Two operating modes: continuous and touch-activated. Heavy-duty non-slip base and replaceable cup head. Suitable for mixing research samples in test tubes up to 30mm diameter.
description: Benchtop vortex mixer. 0–3000 rpm continuous and touch-activated modes.

name: Microcentrifuge — 24-Place
shortDescription: Benchtop refrigerated microcentrifuge. 24 × 1.5/2mL tubes, up to 15,000 rpm.
longDescription:
Benchtop refrigerated microcentrifuge with a 24-place fixed-angle rotor accepting 1.5mL and 2mL tubes. Maximum speed 15,000 rpm / 21,130 × g. Brushless motor, soft-touch lid lock, short-spin function, and programmable profiles.

Ideal for DNA/RNA/protein sample preparation and routine benchwork.
description: Benchtop refrigerated microcentrifuge. 24 × 1.5/2mL tubes, up to 15,000 rpm.

name: pH Meter — Benchtop
shortDescription: Benchtop pH / mV / temperature meter with ATC probe and calibration standards.
longDescription: Benchtop pH meter with simultaneous pH, mV, and temperature readout. Includes a glass-body combination electrode with automatic temperature compensation and a three-point calibration kit (pH 4.01 / 7.00 / 10.01). Stores up to 500 data points with timestamp.
description: Benchtop pH / mV / temperature meter with ATC probe and calibration standards.

name: Micropipette Set — 10 / 100 / 1000 μL
shortDescription: Three-pipette variable-volume set. 0.5–10, 10–100, and 100–1000 μL ranges.
longDescription: Three autoclavable single-channel variable-volume micropipettes covering 0.5–10 μL, 10–100 μL, and 100–1000 μL. Individually factory calibrated with traceable certificates. Ergonomic housing with ejector and stainless tip cone. Compatible with universal pipette tips.
description: Three-pipette variable-volume set. 0.5–10, 10–100, and 100–1000 μL ranges.
